target: Application retrieval latency for equal-information complete explanation queries; not database-engine-only latency or human effort
order: Seeded shuffle of workload-engine pairs in each repetition
engines: In-process SQLite and localhost HTTP Neo4j, both on the same server; transport asymmetry reported
cache: Warm operational cache; no OS-cache flushing or cold-cache claim
timed_boundary: Execute retrieval and fully consume returned rows; canonical normalization and digest verification recorded separately
acceptance: Every complete normalized output equals source reconstruction and both implementations; zero tolerated differences
extension_measure: Number of distinct retrieval-query texts across pre-existing scope extensions, not authoring time or general extensibility
scope: Existing June data; no scale extrapolation, human-effort or universal engine-speed claim
